channel.title: The Awesome Ledger — awesome-AutoHotkey
channel.description: New entries across the GitHub awesome ecosystem, diffed nightly.

item.title: AU accounting hotkeys — via awesome-AutoHotkey
item.description: Types Australian financial year dates and period labels, with a searchable picker, ABN and ACN formatting and draft workpaper snippets.

item.title: ALTRun — via awesome-AutoHotkey
item.description: A lightweight, open-source Alfred-style launcher for Windows. For apps, files (with Everything), web searches, calculations, clipboard history and snippets. Written in AutoHotkey v2.

item.title: WinClip — via awesome-AutoHotkey
item.description: by Deo - WinClip is a clipboard manipulation class extending AutoHotkey's clipboard capabilities including support for RTF, HTML and images. Forum thread: link.

item.title: SpicyKeys — via awesome-AutoHotkey
item.description: Use hotkeys to open or move/copy selected files in Windows Explorer. Forum thread: link

item.title: PYAHK — via awesome-AutoHotkey
item.description: Documentation for the Python interface. The original download link is no longer available.

item.title: .NET Framework Interop (CLR, C#, VB) — via awesome-AutoHotkey
item.description: Forum thread and documentation for the CLR library. The original download link is no longer available.

item.title: Layout Switch — via awesome-AutoHotkey
item.description: Shows the keyboard-layout code (EN, DE, …) in a badge right under the text caret on every layout change, like macOS' input source indicator, and cycles through a chosen list of languages with a macOS-style hotkey. Works over Win+S and the Start menu, follows the system accent colour, per-monitor DPI aware.
